title: observability: token-kv-logging-dashboard-enhancements-and-alert-tuning
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add token/KV logging hooks, new Grafana dashboards for token-level cost & KV cache metrics, and tuned alert thresholds for high tail latency and KV-miss spike; non-breaking.
description: Context: production telemetry showed recurring high tail token-latency incidents and opaque KV cache miss patterns that made root-cause analysis slow. Motivation: provide richer token-level and KV metrics, consistent logging, and dashboards so SRE and product teams can quickly triage cost/latency regressions. Summary of changes: 1) Add a TokenKVLogger abstraction to runtime to emit structured token-level events (token_id, model, seq_len, kv_hit, kv_latency_ms, batch_id, route). 2) Wire logger into the runtime request path and KV cache layer with sampling and dynamic rate limit config to avoid QPS blowup. 3) Add new Grafana dashboard JSON and k8s alert rules focusing on: token-cost-per-minute, token-tail-latency (p50/p95/p99), kv-cache-hit-rate, kv-miss-spike, and per-model cost breakdown. 4) Tune alerts to reduce noisy pages: use 5m and 30m windows, add suppression for transient bursts, and separate warnings vs paging thresholds. 5) Add migration docs and observability playbook entry describing how to use the dashboards and runbooks for common incidents. Backwards compatibility: logging emits a new structured event but falls back to previous metrics-only path when the logger is disabled; changes are behind config flags for private deployments. Testing: unit tests for logger and exporters, integration tests that validate emitted metrics and sample dashboard panels, load test showing <2% overall CPU overhead at 10k rps and no observable P99 latency regression. Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout to internal staging -> canary in prod (10%) for 24h -> gradual ramp; alerts default to warning in canary. Rollback: disable logger feature-flag or revert alert-rule ConfigMap. Merge notes: squash-merged after approvals and CI green.
commits_summary: 3 commits: add token_kv_logger and interfaces; add grafana dashboard and alert rules; fix tests and tune thresholds based on reviewer feedback
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Nice incremental design. Two asks: (1) add a sampling config and default to 1/1000 to avoid cost spikes; (2) add a unit test for the kv_latency_ms histogram buckets.
Aisha Patel (author): Added sampling config and unit test in commit 3, addressed histogram buckets and documented default. Response included benchmarks showing <2% CPU overhead.
Sofia Martinez: Alert tuning looks reasonable; can we change the paging threshold to p99>1200ms sustained over 5m? Also request suppression for deploy windows.
Aisha Patel: Tuned paging threshold to p99>1200ms and added 30m suppression window and an annotation for deploy-suppression. Updated alert docs.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after verifying dashboard panels render with sane defaults in staging. Left a minor nit about panel legends.
Automated CI: telemetry-test-matrix passed; dashboard-render test was flaky and fixed in follow-up commit.
notes: Follow-up planned to add per-tenant sampling config (ENG-7901) and rollout automation for private deployments.
